description: The bar chart illustrates the execution accuracy of two different strategies, NatSQL and another unnamed strategy, across four categories of complexity: Simple, Moderate, Challenging, and Total. In the 'Moderate' category, NatSQL shows an accuracy of 39.64%, and the other strategy has 48.60%. For 'Challenging' tasks, NatSQL has an accuracy of 32.32%, and the other strategy has 36.11%. The 'Total' category shows NatSQL with an accuracy of 51.35% and the other strategy with 56.19%. The chart does not indicate any specific sorting or emphasis on the bars, and no additional visual elements such as shading or annotations are present.
